title: Flow-style YAML documents
summary: Parse YAML written in flow style (inline mappings and sequences, in one line or over several, as in generated exports and Helm values) into plain data.
notes: Only YAML parsers take part. JavaScript adapters return the parsed value, which is checked for deep equality with the data the document was written from. Rust adapters return the crate's own parsed tree; converting it to JSON for the same check happens outside measured work.
